title: Watch the Preprocessor
prompt: Implement `int pipeline_probe(void)`: define a macro `#define GROW(n) ((n) + 1)` and return `GROW(GROW(4))` — then verify by hand what the preprocessor produced: the expansion is ((4) + 1) + 1. Also implement `const char *include_probe(void)` returning __FILE__ — the preprocessor's own record of the translation unit.

tests.name: __FILE__ is preprocessor state
tests.hint: The file macro is a non-empty string naming this translation unit.
